name: Timothy Scotts Jr.
source:
Timothy is a superfan of the Texans, and more specifically, [url=/c148299]Jimmie Underwood[/url]. Taking it upon himself, he followed Underwood to A&N and offered to finance a majority of their reimaging for nothing in return but attendance to every game.
